intent.problem_statement: The application currently has two disjointed views: a 'Main Dashboard' (Overview) and an 'Audit Report' (Results). Switching between them feels 'weird' as they behave like separate apps rather than a unified product experience.
success_metrics: Unified UX where Audit Results are actionable metadata within the Dashboard
Clear navigation path between Overview and specific Scan details
No more 'view-switching' that loses context of the product core

constraints.performance_requirements: Instant transition between report and overview

logic_flows: Scan Finish -> Transform Red Flags to Recommendations
Trigger View Transition back to 'dashboard' Overview

decisions.title: Selected Option A: Feed-Injection Model
decisions.rationale: Direct conversion of audit results into actionable tasks leads to higher user engagement and a cohesive SaaS product experience.
